reviews.text: Lovely spa! They squeezed us in for a speedy yet thorough bath and fluff after Maple had too much fun in the mud. Kind and gentle staff, Maple walked right in and was chilled when she left (she loves a good spa session). We didn’t have time to stay for the full blow dry, that’s why her ears are a bit damp in the “after” photo.
I am really happy with my experience here- the price was better than anywhere else I could find, they did an amazing job and were very convenient to book with- we will definitely keep coming back!
Great groomers! Fantastic service and friendly staff. Highly recommended
Thank you so much, really appreciate this.

We've been bringing our dog here for many years. The service and care for our dog is absolutely top notch.

November 2024 update: New location - with convenient parking - same expert grooming.

November 2025: Cannot fault the expertise, customer care or prices. Be sure to book at the right place though - on Chamberlayne Road, NW10 as there are apparently some imitators around.

July 2025: As good as ever. Clean, fluffy and happy dog.

Brought my corgi in for a deshed groom - she looked good and tidy, i can still pull out clumps of her fur so I assume it’s just excess shedding. They didn’t shape her butt floof so asked for it to be done and one groomer literally just shaved the floof off… not exactly what i asked for. Had to bring her home and trim it myself as it was very haphazard and obviously just shaved quickly.

She was not distressed and smells lovely. Nice staff so will be coming back but will make sure I’m extra clear on what I want next time!
Really happy with Just Barking, our 2nd visit and our show cocker looks wonderful with his new summer cut. Thank you.
We’re always really pleased with the hand stripping service for our terrier

Milo had his first visit today and would highly recommend.

Staff were friendly and caring.
Thanks so much, really pleased by this!
Lovely, Thank You!
Excellent service

I went just barking today for the first time and I’m very happy with the grooming result . The owner he was very nice, polite, professional, less then two hours my 1 year old toy poodle was done looking very cute and handsome . I will use this service again in future . Recommended .

Just Barking accommodated my old, deaf and very nervous dog at late notice and v thoughtfully, making sure that the salon was quiet and that he could be in and out in the shortest possible time to cause him the least distress. Thank you!
The team at Just Barking always does an amazing job grooming my two golden retrievers! They are always very friendly and responsive. Highly recommend them for your grooming needs!

Just Barking is great and they have completed an excellent groom on my cockapoo. I have used them for years; the quality of the experience for Gozo and Bosco my dogs is excellent and so I am very glad I remain on their books.

Just Barking offer a fantastic dog grooming service. My little cockapoo always come back looking lovely and smelling great! The staff are really experienced and friendly and are great at making the dogs feel relaxed. I can't recommend then enough
Fantastic service and one very happy bunny........ well doggy when we picked up the lovely Zeus.  Good old fashioned service from start to finish what more can one ask for.
Great expeience from m tart to finish with Just barking. Very easy to organise and they did a fab job of the grooming - will definitely be back.
Mozzie had a great groom again at just barking at their new location . Smelling and looking great!

Just Barking has been grooming my dog Bubbles since she was a puppy and they are the nicest people, great groomers and have some amazing accessories for your canine friend. They listen to what you want and I've never been disappointed.  I would never consider going anywhere else.

Our 12 week old puppy had her first grooming session today so it was important that we choose the right groomers as a bad experience can make puppy’s anxious about future grooming visits. The staff were friendly and our puppy came out of her appointment relaxed and happy. Just Barking also has parking on site, which is useful. The price was very reasonable and we will definitely be using their services again.
lovely people, my cockapoo loves it here. Also very convenient for the parking!
Best dog groomer , everyone is so lovely. My dog Rollo always comes back looking great , if you’re ever looking for a groomer in the NW / west London area this is the place to go 100% !
Nala always looks so beautiful when she visits Just Barking,  staff are friendly and professional.  Highly recommend 👌 …
thanks so much Moisés, really appreciate :-)

I love Just Barking.  They are always delightful, my dog (a working cocker spaniel) comes out happy and looking lovely, and I love the fact that they have a sonic toothbrush and clean his teeth - so much more economical than the vet.  Plus their new premises has parking so you can easily drop off and pick up.  The only downside is that you sometimes have to leave a message to make an appointment, but they do always call back.  Oh - and they are busy (because they are good.)  But hey ho, you can't have everything..
My dog had a very lovely groom here; I’ve never been disappointed.. thanks so much

Fantastic groomer he knows exactly what I want done to my dogs.
They take  care of my babies both pebbles and sooty are happy to go for a nice bath and groom.
Highly recommend
Fantastic results over many years for my 16 year old Bichon. First class groomers and the owners are very welcoming, caring and knowledgeable. Recommend without hesitation. Sarah
Always excellent service….perfect cut…Binky always looks goooooooooorgeous!!!!
Very good at grooming, my boy Snowy was looked after very well 😀 …

We adopted dog a 1.5yrs ago who was very nervous and reactive to almost everything. When we made the enquiry for grooming I actually expected a no, but I was greeted with a very confident, positive response. The staff member took lots of details and assured me Tilly was in good hands. They did not lie! From greeting to goodbye they delivered a great service and Tilly looked so cute like all Yorkies should!
Thank you Just Barking staff for making Tilly’s and my first groom a pleasure and not an ordeal

We have been taking our beloved dog to Just Barking for years and can't recommend them highly enough. They have moved premises and whilst the venue is slightly less glamorous the service is still amazing.
Friendly staff and always accommodating ❤️

We have been taking our Shiba many years to Just Barking and he loves it so much that he almost do not want to leave. Great place, fantastic service and very reasonably priced. Warmly recommend!  😃😃😃 …
Thanks so much Zainab, sincerely appreciate :-)

Excellent team whom I trust to do the hand stripping for my English cocker spaniel. After having tried many providers at different costs this was the most reliable, great work and best price provider in North West London. Highly recommend this team!

Have used Just Barking for several years. I wouldn’t trust my little blind and deaf dog, PiBaer, with anyone else. I enjoy the leads and collars the sel, and now, since the move, they’re even closer to the house…and there’s parking at the new venue.
Been going for 8 years - excellent service, need to get the little collar bows back though

I highly recommend Just Barking.  The staff are wonderful; always friendly and welcoming.  I have a little rescue Schnoodle who is very anxious after a cruel start, but she is welcomed warmly & treated with kindness. The groomers are patient, and gentle and over time she began to trust. She always comes out super soft, looking gorgeous and smelling great.  Thank you Just Barking!
Very good.

Thank you to a great team for doing a wonderful  job on my west highland terrier  Reilly he looks great keep up the good work
From a very happy customer

Our 4.7 year old Lab mix, Deben, has been a client at Just Barking since he was a young pup.
We always find Just Barking's washes fabulous, fierce, and leave our Deben looking almost show room ready with the wash and teeth cleaning combo.
(And of course the doggy treats)😉.
Here's to 50 more years of service to Just Barking!!!.👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻

I have been using Just Barking Dog Grooming for my Cockapoo for about 3 years now!  I am always happy with the end product and of their treatment of her whilst she is there!    Koki can be quite anxious but is finally getting more comfortable to go there as they are very caring.   I would highly recommend them.

I’ve been bringing my little Cavalier to Just Barking for years, first to their original location and now to their new one, and I couldn’t be happier. Their grooming is consistently excellent, but what keeps me coming back is the kindness and care their team shows my pup. He practically dances with excitement the moment we walk through the door.

The owners are genuinely good people who take real pride in the service they provide, and it shows. Everyone I know in the local area has nothing but great things to say about Just Barking as well.

One quick tip: double-check their new address before you go. Google Maps can be a little confusing since another groomer recently opened near their old spot.

Highly recommend!
Really fab groomers, my rescue Pekingese is beautifully groomed and cleaned and I’m delighted with their service and reasonable prices.
Always do a fantastic job on my pooch. Warm and friendly
We have used Just Barking for close to 10 years and are very happy with their service -- though I have to admit Romy (our dog) doesn't always love it!

My dog has been lovingly cared for by the staff at Just Barking all his 9+ years. It has to be a 5* recommendation when he pulls at the lead to get in at the door of the new location just as hard as he did at the old. Thanks for a great service!

My dog - Peanut - loves Just Barking. We tried a few places over the last 5 years but keep coming back here. With the new location it’s a bit further to drive but easier to park - so a win for us. Great service and I know I’m leaving my dog in great hands.

Just Barking do an amazing job with my Welsh Terrier. It’s a challenging breed to groom, but they always make her look fantastic, maintaining that classic terrier shape without ever looking over-done. She is loves going there and is always happy to go in, which is the best testament I can give. They have a team of brilliant and skilled groomers, and their new location makes it so easy to park while you drop off and pick up.
Highly recommended!

V sorry you were unable to book an appointment with us on the same day you rang (totally agree that the heat has been oppressive) and at the time you would have liked. We recommend booking a few days or more in advance. Thanks for your understanding.
Friendly staff and an excellent groom
Much appreciated Ben!
Leo looking very handsome after his cut and I love how quick it was too as he can get quite stressed at the groomer’s. Great new location and much easier parking! Thanks again, we’ll be back 🐶 …

So happy with my dog Harriots cut/groom, the best l have had, and lovely friendly team and also very knowledgeable. This was my first time as have just moved to area, will now be going back regularly. Will definitely recommend them!!
Only here can they deal with my dog

Just barking has been a consistent part of my dog since he was a puppy. My dog is now coming to 3 in the summer and we took him to just barking when he was just a puppy. I remembered being nervous and not sure but just barking and the team made it so easy for us. I was so shocked to see how handsome my dog looked and what a great job was done. The service they provide is impeccable and quite affordable. What I like about just barking is the price they tell you exactly what’s included. I have also tried their other services like dog teeth cleaning again impeccable. The best part about it is how happy my dog feels while going and coming out. I would like to thank Gabriele who is so welcoming and kind not only towards my dog but to us. He always makes sure and suggests what would be the best in terms of grooming. He never pushes you to spend more but only advices my dog may need a service like teeth cleaning. 2 reasons for me to go there is Gabriele and the lovely team behind doors who make sure to make my dog look his best and clean. So thank you for everything.
Thanks so much Ross, really appreciate!

I’m a so upset. My dog has been a regular at just barking for 6 years. I know they moved premises but I was not aware there are all new staff. I pay £65 every 6 weeks for a groom that is supposed to include an ear clean. My dogs ears have not been cleaned, toe nails left long. And now as a result I have incurred a hefty vet bill for an ear infection. The vet confirmed the ears have definitely not been cleaned. I think as regular customers for many years, it is common courtesy to advise if there are new staff and a change in the grooming services. I will not be returning
Thanks so much Benedetta! xx

I am new to this area and needed to find a good place for my dog to get groomed. I came across this place and I am very happy that I did as the staff are some of the most friendly, skilled and helpful I have ever come across. I love taking my dog here to get groomed, as they always do a great job. They have fantastic equipment which maximises the efficiency. I would 100% recommend this place.

I have found Just Barking to be even better at their new location. They offer more options and flexibility for appointments! They are fantastic with my little pup, who is still getting used to regular sessions at the groomers, and I am very happy with their service and understanding.
Very friendly team, efficient and kind with our dog

I’ve been takkng my bichon frise to just barking  over 8 years mainly because it was literally at my doorstep as it has always been a hit and miss. Today they have completely ruined his coat. Never again
Great service but a bit pricey
Happy  and satisfied as always! My dog loves you all
I have been bringing my dog here for years . I am always very happy with her cut etc..
Nice dog grooming salon with reasonable prices.  They’re extremely helpful with scheduling.  And more importantly, they take really good care of my cavapoochon.
